semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester one builds financial literacy and digital marketing foundations while developing communication, AI literacy, global awareness, and career planning skills for future managers.

courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.

title.strong: Modern Age AI Tools (Generative AI Tools)

courses.text: Explores emerging generative AI technologies, enabling students to apply automation, innovation, and creativity in solving complex business problems across industries.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development I: Career Planning and Goal Setting

courses.text: Focuses on self-awareness, career planning, and effective goal setting, guiding students toward professional growth, leadership readiness, and future career opportunities.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

courses.title: Marketing – The 21st Century Marketing
courses.text: Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

courses.title: Entrepreneurship & Family Business – Entrepreneurship and Family Business 101
courses.text: Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

title.strong: Business Analytics – Driving Decisions by Excel (Basics & Advanced)

courses.text: Master Excel tools from basics to advanced analytics, learning data organization, visualization, forecasting, and decision modeling to transform raw data into actionable business insights.

title.strong: Digital Marketing & Advertising – Introduction to Digital Marketing

courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Semester two blends leadership, sustainability, and design thinking with applied finance and business analytics, emphasizing digital tools, and data-driven decision-making.

courses.text: Strengthens leadership and interpersonal skills through experiential learning. Emphasizes self-awareness, teamwork, communication, and conflict management via role-plays, simulations, and psychometric assessments.
Introduces empathy-based problem-solving. Students practice ideation, prototyping, and testing to create innovative, user-focused business solutions for modern organizational challenges.
Focuses on sustainable business aligned with UN SDGs. Students conduct structured research and evaluate CSR practices to understand ethics, governance, and corporate responsibility globally.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development II: Personal Branding & Professional Networking

courses.text: Develops digital presence, storytelling, and networking skills. Uses LinkedIn optimization, alumni mentoring, and personal coaching to enhance professional branding and opportunities.

items.text: Equips students with tools for evaluating securities, constructing portfolios, and analyzing risk-return trade-offs through case studies, financial databases, and market simulations.
Covers capital structure, cost of capital, working capital, and corporate financing decisions. Uses applied case studies and financial modelling for practical business contexts.
Explores Indian banking, capital markets, NBFCs, and regulatory frameworks. Blends theory with guest lectures from industry professionals and live market exposure.
Focuses on personal financial planning, investment advisory, and estate management. Students design client portfolios, integrating taxation, insurance, and retirement planning strategies.
Explores campaign planning, media mix optimization, brand communication, and ROI measurement. Students create multi-channel advertising strategies for target audiences.
Covers social media marketing, content strategy, audience engagement, and community building. Students manage live campaigns, measure performance, and optimize engagement metrics.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Semester three integrates economics, cybersecurity, and emotional intelligence with advanced finance and digital marketing skills, preparing students for strategic, tech-enabled leadership roles.

title.strong: Organisational Behaviour and Universal Human Values

courses.text: Explores individual and group behavior, ethical decision-making, and value-driven leadership. Students apply human-centric principles to enhance workplace harmony and sustainable business practices.
Introduces cybersecurity frameworks, threat intelligence, incident response, and regulatory compliance. Students engage with real-world scenarios to protect organizational digital assets.
Applies micro and macroeconomic principles to managerial contexts. Covers demand-supply analysis, pricing, market structures, and policy implications for informed business decisions.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development III: Emotional Intelligence & Resilience

courses.text: Develops self-awareness, adaptability, and resilience in leadership. Students participate in coaching, simulations, and reflective exercises to manage stress and lead effectively.
